lines.vo: What if you saved one more dollar every single week?
That's not pocket change. That's a ladder.
Rio logs every deposit in his Money Mastery Budget Planner.
Week one, you save one dollar. Week two, two dollars. All the way to week fifty two.
lines.cap: Week 1, you save $1. Week 2, $2. All the way to week 52.

lines.vo: Add up all fifty two weeks, and you've saved one thousand three hundred seventy eight dollars.
lines.cap: Add up all 52 weeks, and you've saved $1,378.

lines.vo: The early weeks feel tiny. About three quarters of the money lands in the second half.
Tiny starts build the habit before the amounts get big.
One more dollar, every week. That's how you stay on track.
